=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/sync_contract_list_union.py:183-276 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: merge_contract/_resolve/_validate never read the base list; _validate only checks `expected = set(ours_list) | set(theirs_list)`, so a hunk where both sides replace the same base entry (or one side deletes and the other appends) passes as a "two-sided append".
  WHY: The poller commits and pushes a contract that drops the base entry or brings back a deleted one, and it records last_sync_outcome=merged-deterministic, so the LLM resolver is never dispatched; this contradicts the documented "only appends to read_entrypoints / write_entrypoints" contract, and no test covers it (test_one_sided_hunk_is_ineligible covers only a one-sided removal); all reviewers that stated a severity said MAJOR.
- scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:1615-1628 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: STALL_RECOVERY_LATCH_LABELS includes "ai:workflow-heal-escalated", but dependency_wait_resume.SEED_HUMAN_LATCH_LABELS (75-83) and workflow_failure_heal.HUMAN_NEEDED_LABELS (53-61) do not, so tests/test_dependency_wait_resume.py:800 test_seed_human_latch_labels_cover_repo_latch_sets fails (job 131589818592).
  WHY: The required lint aggregate fails ("CI jobs that did not succeed: tests-hooks-and-orchestrator, orchestrate-poll") and blocks merge. Both reviewers agree the mismatch comes from the base branch, not this PR. They disagree on the fix: sonnet says the fix is outside issue #9417's files_touched grant and needs a separate fix on main, while glm says the editor can fix it inside this PR.
- tests/test_dependency_wait_resume.py:800 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The parity assertion test_seed_human_latch_labels_cover_repo_latch_sets fails because orchestrate_lib.STALL_RECOVERY_LATCH_LABELS includes 'ai:workflow-heal-escalated' and SEED_HUMAN_LATCH_LABELS does not.
  WHY: The tests-hooks-and-orchestrator job fails and blocks CI; the source stated no severity, so medium is a placeholder. Same root cause as the orchestrate_lib.py entry above, but a different file, so it is kept separate.
- scripts/stage_support_for_phase.sh:85-333 (also scripts/run_plan_codex.sh:308-666, .github/workflows/clarify.yml:2397, .github/workflows/plan.yml:2355-2363, 3395-3399) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The latest autofix run edited clarify.yml, plan.yml, run_plan_codex.sh and stage_support_for_phase.sh, plus agents.d/stuck-states-p2b-implement-support-scripts.md. These are stuck-states P2b support-scripts staging changes (SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_DIR / RUN_PLAN_CODEX_SUPPORT_DIR, optional persistence helpers), and they are outside linked issue #9417's files_touched grant.
  WHY: It ships behaviour changes to unrelated workflow modes in a PR whose approved scope excludes those files. Both reviewers said MAJOR; glm found no runtime failure (the edits are internally consistent). Sonnet disagrees: it says none of these files is in pr_changed_files.txt, so the last-run diff shows base-branch content.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml (jobs orchestrate-poll (0) job 131589818650, tests-hooks-and-orchestrator job 131589818592) | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The orchestrate-poll (0) shard fails, but its log tail shows only PASS lines and the pre-push gate lists it as "Unverified: timeout". None of the four new P12 poller tests (tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:32828-32922) has a confirmed pass, and the gate also attributes failures in unrelated tests to this change.
  WHY: The required lint aggregate is red and the new merge-path behaviour is unverified; the named tests and the P12 poller tests need to be rerun in isolation.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:32828-32922 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The new poller tests (test_integration_sync_contract_list_union_merges_without_dispatch, etc.) are unverified because the CI shard orchestrate-poll (0) timed out.
  WHY: The new merge-path behaviour is not confirmed to pass in a clean test run; the source stated no severity, so medium is a placeholder.
- scripts/sync_contract_list_union.py:135-184 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The marker parsing in _resolve relies on a brittle regex and may raise Ineligible for valid conflict structures or accept malformed markers as list appends.
  WHY: A marker structure that deviates from simple appends could be misclassified or incorrectly merged; the source stated no severity, so medium is a placeholder.
- scripts/sync_contract_list_union.py:145-165 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: _run_merge_file raises only on return codes outside 0-127 and always feeds proc.stdout to _resolve, without telling conflict exit codes apart from error exit codes (e.g. exit 2 = binary).
  WHY: A non-conflict merge-file error yields the wrong reason (markers_remain), which gives no useful diagnosis on fallback.
- scripts/sync_contract_list_union.py:263-269 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The base_missing guard rejects only an empty or missing base; a base of whitespace, comments or a non-mapping document passes, and _load_mapping may return an empty dict or a non-dict.
  WHY: The helper may produce a merge that looks deterministic against a base that was never really parsed.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:12495-12515 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: In the sync_contract_list_union_merge subshell, a `cd "${wt}"` failure (exit 9) and generic exit 1 fall into the catch-all as `subshell_exit_9` / `subshell_exit_1` instead of explicit reasons, and the log at line 12469 emits `branch=` even when integration_branch is empty.
  WHY: The real cause is masked (e.g. `reason=worktree`), which makes incident triage harder.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:605-611 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The P12 step `python3 -m pip install --quiet 'pyyaml==6.0.2'` adds a network dependency at the start of the poll job and has no step timeout of its own.
  WHY: A pip network timeout can stall the poller tick before any state is read; the expanded network-egress capability is not acknowledged in the workflow contract.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: The helper "keeps the entries from both sides" and accepts only a "two-sided append of same-indent `- item` lines under read_entrypoints: / write_entrypoints:" (changelog + agents.d text both say "only appends to read_entrypoints / write_entrypoints").
  expected_change_site: scripts/sync_contract_list_union.py near `_validate` (lines 230-260)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The validation only enforces `merged == ours ∪ theirs` and never compares ours and theirs to the base list; a hunk where both sides replaced the same base entry passes, and the PR diff has no strict-additive check (`set(base_list) <= set(ours_list)` AND `set(base_list) <= set(theirs_list)`).
- requirement: The implementation must be limited to the paths in the issue #9417 plan grant: scripts/sync_contract_list_union.py, scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml, .github/workflows/ci.yml, tests/test_sync_contract_list_union.py, tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py, README.md, docs/INVENTORY.md, agents.d/stuck-states-p12-contract-list-union.md, changelog.d/stuck-states-p12-contract-list-union.md, tests/**, changelog.d/*, agents.d/*.
  expected_change_site: All files in the PR / LAST RUN DIFF should be limited to the grant above
  confidence=5

  expected_change_site: PR CI run for the head SHA 272566376ea69cfa616f56e8cf41f32e75fda523
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The pre-push gate shows test_integration_sync_contract_list_union_mixed_paths_falls_open, test_integration_sync_contract_list_union_disabled_matches_legacy and test_integration_sync_contract_list_union_merges_without_dispatch as "not run". The tests-hooks-and-orchestrator and orchestrate-poll matrix groups both failed (run 43335290177), and tests-orchestrate-pinned-sandbox never completed.
- requirement: Stuck-states P12 (PR title / linked issue #9417): the lint gate "CI jobs that did not succeed" must be green.
  expected_change_site: scripts/dependency_wait_resume.py line 75-83 (`SEED_HUMAN_LATCH_LABELS`) and/or scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py line 53-61 (`HUMAN_NEEDED_LABELS`) and/or scripts/orchestrate_lib.py line 1624-1628 (`STALL_RECOVERY_LATCH_LABELS`)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: tests/test_dependency_wait_resume.py:800 fails with `Extra items in the left set: 'ai:workflow-heal-escalated'`. The label is in STALL_RECOVERY_LATCH_LABELS (added for issue #9248) but missing from SEED_HUMAN_LATCH_LABELS and HUMAN_NEEDED_LABELS. This PR did not introduce the mismatch, but the merge is blocked until it is fixed.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/sync_contract_list_union.py:263-276 (merge_contract), 185-202 (_resolve), 248 (_validate) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The helper never checks that merge-base entries survive on both sides: when both sides replace "- a.py:x" with y and z, or one side deletes and appends while the other only appends, the hunk passes as a union.
  WHY: sync_contract_list_union_merge commits and pushes a contract that drops the base entry or brings back a deleted one, recording merged-deterministic, which contradicts the changelog.d/agents.d contracts; this is untested. Suggested fix: load base_data in _validate and raise Ineligible("list_not_union") when any base item is missing from ours_list or theirs_list.
- scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:1615-1627 (STALL_RECOVERY_LATCH_LABELS); tests/test_dependency_wait_resume.py:800 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: CI job tests-hooks-and-orchestrator (job 131589818592) fails with "Extra items in the left set: 'ai:workflow-heal-escalated'"; none of these files is in the PR diff, so the mismatch comes from the base branch.
  WHY: The required lint aggregate fails and blocks the PR; the fix belongs in scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py / scripts/dependency_wait_resume.py, which are outside issue #9417's grant and need a separate fix on main.
- Notes (dissent on the pass-1 ledger, 3 related items): (1) the out-of-scope last-run edits (clarify.yml, plan.yml, run_plan_codex.sh, stage_support_for_phase.sh) do not hold, because pr_changed_files.txt lists only the 10 P12 files and RUN_PLAN_CODEX_SUPPORT_DIR is defined at scripts/run_plan_codex.sh line 7; (2) pre-push gate failures are not caused by this change, e.g. tests/test_agents_fragment_contract.py::test_instructions_point_at_fragments (lines 74-82), the agents.d
